messages:
morgan: FYI pre-merge canary for matmul-quant-v2 tonight 23:30 PST. Deploybot will shift 1% -> 10% over 30m. Telemetry gating only. Need smoke + perf + cost sanity.

saina: thanks. which regions?

morgan: sfo + iad primary, region fallback to gcp-europe for read-only.

ryan: who's oncall for runtime tonight?

jihoon: i'm primary 23:00-03:00 PT. carla is backup.

carla: noted. will watch kv eviction & p99 latency.

morgan: rollback criteria (rough): p99 increase > 15% sustained 10m, error rate > 0.5%, or any reproducing segfaults. if any, immediate 100% rollback via Deploybot.

saina: can we get a quick smoke checklist here? small set of prompts + perf script.

morgan: put this in the deploy message: 
```
deploybot canary --service=runtime-engine --bundle=matmul-quant-v2 --traffic=1,10 --duration=30m --regions=sfo,iad
```

morgan: smoke script: `scripts/smoke/matmul_v2_smoke.sh` (warm kv cache, 8 token seqs, 512 tokens)

ryan: add cost telemetry: token-cost-per-100k and gpu-util spike. I've added graphs to the canary dashboard.

deploybot: Deploy initiated by @morgan. Canary window starts 2026-03-20T23:30:00-07:00. Traffic slices: 1% -> 10%.

opsbot: Alert rule test: will notify #eng-oncall and #eng-runtime if p99 > baseline+15%.

jihoon: release notes: short blurb for engineers + note for Dedicated customers about pinning: "matmul-quant-v2: improved throughput, possible memory footprint changes; Dedicated customers should pin driver 530.XX or use fallback-quant-compat"

carla: can you paste PR link for RN? I will do final copy edit.

morgan: PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/release-notes/pull/482

saina: quick question: do we need to pre-warm caches? how many replicas to pre-bake?

morgan: pre-warm: 2 replicas per AZ for 15m prior; prebake job: `jobs/prebake_matmul_v2.yaml` in infra repo.

ryan: noted. I'll watch for KV cache thrash during first 10m.

jihoon: if we see p99 regressions but errors ok, we can enable continuous batching throttle in-flight as a mitigation, then re-evaluate.

carla: will update release note with mitigation steps and rollback commands.

morgan: final ask: someone please publish RN summary to #announcements if canary passes. I can do it if no one else.

saina: I'll take announcements if it passes.

carla: all set from docs side. good luck :rocket:

morgan: thanks all. ping me in thread if any alarms. :thumbsup:
